validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real and operating. The line's own cited sources hold up: Shana 646387 (2024-09-12) and Mehr 6223369 report the successful gas injection into the NEW Rasht-Chelavend line in Sep 2024, both naming the pipeline explicitly (independent Iranian outlets, not one reprint). News Central Asia 2023-02-16 (verified 200 + content) independently describes the 150 km / 42 in / 15 mcm-d (5.5 bcm/y) line and its construction. The generic eurasianet gas-swaps piece does NOT name the pipeline (200 but 'operating' token absent) and is weak support on its own, but the Shana/Mehr/NCA trio more than covers existence. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas transmission trunk feeding the northwest grid and the Iran-Azerbaijan/Turkmenistan swap corridor at the Astara border; not gathering/plant-internal, not an oil/condensate line. DUPLICATE: cleared. No other roster row covers Rasht->Chelavend. The GulfPub 'Sarakhs - Mashad - Neka - Rasht' line (36 in, 735 km) TERMINATES at Rasht and is the upstream trunk, not this coastal continuation; GulfPub's Dec-2025 Iran gas set has no Rasht-Chelavend feature (expected omission for a 2024 line). Do NOT confuse with the separate, shorter 'Chelavend-Ardabil' line (55 km, 30 in, per IRNA 85647191 / Shana 630431) which branches inland from Chelavend. SPEC: length 150 km, diameter 42 in, capacity 5.5 bcm/y (15 mcm/d) all agree across NCA + irandaily + Persian coverage -> high. Construction 2019 / start-up Sep 2024 consistent with the reporting.

validity.researcher_notes: Two attribution errors. (1) OWNER/OPERATOR: the sheet lists Owner = 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC) 100%. This is a domestic GAS TRANSMISSION line; in Iran gas transmission is built/operated by the National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC) and its transmission subsidiary (IGTC), not NIOC (the oil company). NCA reporting and the Persian coverage attribute the build to NIGC ('The NIGC started construction of the gas pipeline in 2019'); NCA's Iran-Azerbaijan swap reporting is likewise NIGC-framed. NIOC appears to be a default/mis-set owner. (2) ENDPOINT COUNTRY: EndCountryOrArea = 'Azerbaijan' is wrong. Chelavend (chelavand / cholvand, chluwnd) is a coastal village in Astara County, Gilan province, IRAN, just south of Astara on the Caspian; the pipe runs entirely inside Iran and terminates at the Chelavend booster/compressor station near the border. The Azerbaijan link is the swap PURPOSE (gas handed to the existing Astara interconnect), not the physical terminus. End should read Chelavend / Gilan / Iran. Separately, StartLocation is blank though StartState=Gilan; FuelSource='Rasht' is the injection city (national-grid tie-in), not a gas field/source, and is questionable but low-priority.

routes.end_name: Chelavend, Astara County, Gilan, Iran (booster/compressor station near the Azerbaijan border)
routes.corridor_desc: Runs ~150 km northwest along the Gilan Caspian coastal plain from the Rasht grid tie-in, following the coastal corridor (Anzali -> Rezvanshahr/Talesh/Hashtpar -> Astara) to a booster/compressor station at Chelavend, a coastal village just south of Astara at the Azerbaijan border. Corridor is tightly bounded by geography (narrow coastal strip between the Talesh/Alborz foothills and the Caspian) and by the two named endpoints; the 150 km length matches the ~150-180 km Rasht-Astara coastal distance. Endpoint coordinates: Rasht and Astara are well-established; Chelavend is placed ~10 km south of Astara on the coast (approximate, within the Astara/Lavandevil coastal strip) - not a surveyed pipeline coordinate. Current RouteNotes admit the geometry was copied from an IGAT 1 map and shortened, so the existing route is unreliable and should be redrawn along this coastal corridor.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from named places in verified sources: start Rasht (Gilan), end Chelavend near Astara (Gilan, Iran). Waypoint coordinates for Rasht/Anzali/Astara are well-known city coordinates (EPSG:4326); Chelavend is placed approximately on the coast ~10 km south of Astara - flagged approximate, not fabricated to false precision. The line is entirely within Iran; the Azerbaijan swap connection is downstream of Chelavend and NOT part of this pipe's geometry. Corridor is defensible from coastal geography; exact alignment is unpublished, so medium.
